name: independent-release-review
description: Read-only native review of one Showdown graybox revision at a user-supplied 40-character expected_sha, checked out detached and clean. One reviewer step runs scripts/showdown-release-review.mjs (Showdown Node suites, every allowlisted experiment-turn branch, one graybox build, the existing Showdown headless Chrome checks of normal Camp, Trail decision, turn, hidden information, rewards and save isolation), has it re-check its own receipt, and writes a report under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-release-review/<sha>/. No source edits, installs, deploys, pushes or posts. The retired lane/3D recipe is independent-release-review-lane-3d.

steps.prompt:
Expected SHA supplied at launch: `{{expected_sha}}`.

Do not edit tracked files, run npm install or npm ci, deploy, push, open PRs or post anywhere. Write only under .artifacts/. If the expected SHA above is empty or is not exactly 40 lowercase hex characters, do not put it in any command: write the single line `refused: expected_sha missing or malformed` to .artifacts/kiro/showdown-release-review/refused.md and stop with status blocked.

Otherwise run these as separate shell calls and record each literal command and exit status:
1. `git rev-parse HEAD`
2. `git symbolic-ref -q HEAD` (a non-zero exit means detached, which is required)
3. `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all`
4. `node scripts/showdown-release-review.mjs --expected {{expected_sha}}` (takes about three minutes; give it a 10 minute timeout). Exit 0 pass, 1 a check failed, 2 usage, 3 provenance refused.
5. Only if 4 wrote .artifacts/kiro/showdown-release-review/{{expected_sha}}/receipt.json: `node scripts/showdown-release-review.mjs --check-receipt .artifacts/kiro/showdown-release-review/{{expected_sha}}/receipt.json --expected {{expected_sha}}`. Exit 0 accepted, 4 refused.

If 4 exited 3, write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-release-review/{{expected_sha}}/report.md with the refusal text it printed and the verdict line `refused`, and stop with status blocked. Do not work around a refusal (no checkout, stash, clean or rebuild).

Otherwise read receipt.json (not the scripts) and write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-release-review/{{expected_sha}}/report.md with: Source provenance (expected SHA, HEAD before and after, detached, clean, Node version, standalone HTML SHA-256 and bytes); a table of each check (Node suites with pass/total, each turn id with its seed, branch count and problems, the build, each browser check id with exit, seconds, page error count and its last output line) marked match or mismatch against exit 0 and zero problems/errors; the receipt check's exit and output; Pending or blocked (anything the receipt lacks). Limits, each on its own line: these are scripted headless Chrome and Node checks on one Mac and support flow, storage and hidden-information claims only; art and appearance need the art owner's rendered review; clarity and fun need a human playtest; phones, tablets, Safari and other GPUs are not covered; deployed (Pages) identity is not checked. Human approval and art/device approval are separate lines marked pending. No style opinions. Use relative paths only, no home directory. End with one line: `pass`, `fail` or `refused`, which must equal the receipt verdict (or `refused`) and must be `fail` if step 5 refused the receipt.
